ADMIN.description: Password for your relay's admin page at https://<your relay>/admin, where you invite consoles and update the relay. Pick a long one and keep it.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Optional, for the one-click update button: an API token with the Workers Scripts Edit permission (create it at dash.cloudflare.com > My Profile > API Tokens, or with the link in the README). Leave empty to skip.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Optional, with CF_API_TOKEN: your Cloudflare account ID (dashboard > Workers & Pages, right side, "Account ID").

CF_WORKER_NAME.description: The name you give this Worker below. Leave it as ldn-tunnel unless you renamed the Worker.
